description: Lists the selected wedding's places, including empty places with ids and active room counts, plus room descriptions, capacity, status, stay details, stored price and deposit overrides in property order. Guest assignments and occupant identities are excluded. Requires sign-in.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.
